description: This file contains unit tests for the RingRangeCollection class, including tests for containment, intersection, and difference operations, using the Xunit testing framework and property-based testing with CsCheck.

classes.name: RingRangeCollectionTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the RingRangeCollection operations such as containment, intersection, and difference.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Tests whether the collection correctly reports containment of a point.

methods.name: Intersects
methods.description: Tests whether each range in the collection intersects with the collection itself.

methods.name: Difference
methods.description: Tests the difference operation between original and updated ring range collections.

methods.name: ContainsTest
methods.description: Verifies the collection's containment logic for specific points.

methods.name: ContainsWrappedTest
methods.description: Tests containment logic for ranges that wrap around the ring boundary.
